exposure: Post-No Pain Labor N'Delivery phase (epidural analgesia 24/7)
Phase-in period (epidural analgesia 8 a.m.-5 p.m. during weekdays)
outcome: Neonatal intensive care unit admission rate
finding: Implementation of labor epidural analgesia increased the vaginal delivery rate and was found to be safe for both mothers and babies.
mod_finding: Implementation of labor epidural analgesia was associated with an increased vaginal delivery rate and decreased cesarean delivery rate.
